snippet.title: THE MAGIC HOUR: A "Together Again" Sequel | OFFICIAL TEASER TRAILER
snippet.description:
Watch the first official trailer for "The Magic Hour: A Together Again Sequel" now! And follow the game on GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/THE_MAGIC_HOUR/915539
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"The Magic Hour" is a sequel to "Together Again: A Lake's Funland Story" set 20 years after the game's events, it covers a new story full of new faces and new tragedies. Try walking in Reagan Schmidt's shoes as she tries to survive a week at this place, so lively in the day's bright light, but rather obscure and dangerous at night.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Edited by: Heisenmorg
Voice Acting: John Whinfield
Gameplay: Sunken Studios
